# Cinnery

> Cinnery is a cinnamon roll bakery at Zwanestraat 29, 9712 CJ Groningen, the Netherlands. Soft, fluffy cinnamon rolls, baked fresh every day in Groningen. Hand-rolled by best friends. Irresistible cookies and proper coffee.

## Visit

- Address: Zwanestraat 29, 9712 CJ Groningen, the Netherlands
- Card only: We're a cashless bakery. Card and contactless payments only (Pin only, no cash), for a fast, safe and hygienic counter.
- E-mail: cinnery.nl@gmail.com (catering, large orders, custom flavours)
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/cinnery_rolls/
- Website: https://cinnery.nl/ (English and Dutch)

## Menu

All prices in euro, including VAT.

### Cinnamon rolls

- Classic Naked: €6.00 – Soft brioche-style roll with cinnamon sugar, finished with a light, translucent classic glaze.
- Classic Cream Cheese: €6.00 – Soft brioche-style roll with cinnamon sugar, topped with rich and tangy cream cheese frosting.
- Red Velvet: €7.00 – A light cocoa and buttermilk swirl with classic cream cheese frosting, sprinkled with red velvet cake crumbs.
- Biscoff: €7.00 – Brioche-style dough with Biscoff butter and cookie crumbs, finished with a Biscoff cream cheese frosting.
- Pistachio: €7.50 – Brioche-style dough coated with rich pistachio cream and sprinkled with roasted pistachio pieces, covered with pistachio cream cheese frosting.
- Salted Caramel Pecan: €7.50 – Hand-rolled dough with cinnamon sugar, drizzled with rich salted caramel and topped with crunchy roasted pecans.
- Blueberry Crumble: €7.00 – Filled with cinnamon and blueberries, topped off with our signature cream cheese frosting and homemade blueberry compote.

### Savory rolls

- Savory Roll – Weekly Rotating Flavour: €7.00 – Our savory roll changes every week. Ask our staff about this week's flavour.

### Cookies

- Classic Cookie: €5.00 – Thick, chewy and generously loaded. The flavour changes, ask our staff about today's cookie.
- Stuffed Cookie: €5.50 – A soft cookie with a creamy filling. The flavour changes, ask our staff about today's cookie.

### Offers

- Sweet Combo: €8.90 – A classic cinnamon roll or any cookie, plus any coffee, tea or soft drink. Specialty drinks and hot chocos are not included.
- Brunch Combo: €9.90 – The savory roll of the week plus any coffee, tea or soft drink. Specialty drinks and hot chocos are not included.

### Extras

- Extra Classic Cream Cheese Icing: €2.00 – An extra portion of our classic cream cheese icing on your roll.

### Hot choco collection

- Hot Choco: €5.00 – Crafted from the finest premium Dutch cocoa for a rich, velvety chocolate experience.
- Chocomellow: €6.00 – Our signature finest Dutch cocoa topped with a lightly torched marshmallow ring and whipped cream, drizzled with chocolate.

### Coffees & teas

- Espresso: €2.90 – A short, intense shot of our house espresso.
- Double Espresso: €4.00 – Two shots of our house espresso.
- Espresso Macchiato: €3.10 – Espresso marked with a spoon of milk foam.
- Americano: €3.50 – Espresso lengthened with hot water.
- Cappuccino: €3.90 – Espresso with steamed milk and a thick layer of foam.
- Latte Macchiato: €4.50 – Layers of steamed milk and espresso, topped with foam.
- Iced Latte Macchiato: €4.50 – Espresso and cold milk over ice.
- Flat White: €4.50 – A double shot with silky, thin steamed milk.
- Tea – Various Flavours: €2.90 – Ask our staff about today's teas.

### Specialty drinks

- Matcha Latte: €4.50 – Warm matcha with steamed milk.
- Iced Matcha Latte: €4.50 – Matcha with cold milk over ice.
- Prana Chai Latte: €4.50 – Prana chai with steamed milk.
- Seasonal Specialty Drink: €6.00 – A seasonal special, ask our staff what it is right now.

Specialty drinks and hot choco drinks are not included in combos. All prices include VAT.
Vegan options are marked in store.

## Allergens

Our products are handmade in a bakery that handles gluten, dairy, nuts, peanuts and eggs. While we take precautions, cross-contact with allergens may occur, so we cannot guarantee that any item is completely free from them. Please ask our staff about specific ingredients, allergens or dietary alternatives before ordering. Vegan options are marked in store.
